panels.description: Full mask text (pg_stmt_text, collected every 30 min, latest text regardless of the time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT query_mask_md5, c_query_mask AS query_mask FROM (SELECT query_mask_md5, argMax(query_mask, time) AS c_query_mask FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_text WHERE $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY query_mask_md5)

panels.title: Query mask

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, db_instance, usename, sum(if(c_calls < p_calls, c_calls, c_calls - p_calls) / dateDiff('second', pt, t)) AS calls FROM (SELECT t, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, lagInFrame(t, 1, t) OVER w AS pt, c_calls, lagInFrame(c_calls, 1, c_calls) OVER w AS p_calls FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, argMax(calls, time) AS c_calls FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY t, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5 ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE t > pt GROUP BY t, db_instance, usename ORDER BY t

panels.description: Execution time / calls per interval: a step up with steady calls means a plan / data regression.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, db_instance, usename, sum(if(c_total_ms < p_total_ms, c_total_ms, c_total_ms - p_total_ms)) / nullIf(sum(if(c_calls < p_calls, c_calls, c_calls - p_calls)), 0) AS mean_ms FROM (SELECT t, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, lagInFrame(t, 1, t) OVER w AS pt, c_total_ms, lagInFrame(c_total_ms, 1, c_total_ms) OVER w AS p_total_ms, c_calls, lagInFrame(c_calls, 1, c_calls) OVER w AS p_calls FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, argMax(total_exec_time, time) AS c_total_ms, argMax(calls, time) AS c_calls FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY t, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5 ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE t > pt GROUP BY t, db_instance, usename ORDER BY t

panels.description: Statements behind the mask. Click query_md5 to filter the full text below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT db_instance, datname, usename, queryid, query_md5, query_mask_md5, toplevel, c_total_ms AS total_ms, c_calls AS calls, c_rows AS rows, c_blks_read AS blks_read, c_blks_hit AS blks_hit, c_temp_blks_written AS temp_blks_written, c_query AS query, total_ms / nullIf(calls, 0) AS mean_ms FROM (SELECT db_instance, datname, usename, queryid, query_md5, query_mask_md5, toplevel, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(total_exec_time)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(total_exec_time)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_total_ms, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(calls)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(calls)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_calls, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(rows)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(rows)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_rows, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(shared_blks_read)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(shared_blks_read)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_blks_read, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(shared_blks_hit)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(shared_blks_hit)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_blks_hit, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(temp_blks_written)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(temp_blks_written)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_temp_blks_written, argMax(query_short, time) AS c_query FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY db_instance, datname, usename, queryid, query_md5, query_mask_md5, toplevel)

options.content:
# Slow query regression

**Symptom.** Response time of an endpoint grows; DB CPU / IO grows without a matching increase in traffic.

**Where to look.** `pg-statements` → *Top masks* table (sorted by total time over the range) →
click `query_mask_md5` → `pg-statement-detail` (variants by `query_md5`, full text, calls / time series).

**How to interpret.**
- Over the range: `spread(total_exec_time)` = time spent, `spread(calls)` = executions,
  mean = `spread(total_exec_time) / spread(calls)` (ms).
- Compare the same mask for two ranges (before / after release): mean ↑ with calls ≈ → plan / data regression;
  calls ↑ with mean ≈ → more traffic or an N+1 pattern.
- `variants` of a mask ≫ 1 → the same statement shape is produced with different IN-list sizes etc.
- `shared_blks_read` ↑ → data no longer fits the cache ([cache hit drop](cache-hit-drop.md));
  `temp_blks_written` ↑ → sorts / hashes spill ([temp file spills](temp-file-spills.md)).
- `rows / calls` ↑ → the query returns more data (missing filter / pagination).

**Likely causes.** New code path, changed plan (stale statistics, parameter sniffing on generic plans),
missing index, data growth, N+1 queries from the ORM.

**Actions.**
1. Take the full text from `pg_stmt_text` (detail board) and run `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` on a copy.
2. Check [autovacuum / analyze](autovacuum-lag.md) freshness of the involved tables.
3. Check [indexes](unused-missing-indexes.md) for seq-scan-heavy tables involved.
4. For N+1: batch the calls (`= ANY($1)`), which also collapses variants.

**Related SQL.** `sql/cluster_stmt_mask.sql`, `sql/cluster_stmt.sql`, `sql/cluster_stmt_text.sql`.
